issues.concern: The headword 'おる' is not inherently formal. While its humble usage (sense 1) is formal, its regional usage (sense 2) is informal.
The headword 'おる' is not exclusively humble. While its humble usage (sense 1) is humble, its regional usage (sense 2) is plain.
The gloss implies that 'おる' is always humble or regional, but it can be both depending on the context. The current phrasing is misleading.
issues.suggestion: to be; to exist (humble or regional)
